Reference foods use a versioned USDA data mirror. Values are per 100 g edible portion for the exact preparation shown. Source values and units are checked; local recipes and individual portions vary. No dietitian or clinical approval is claimed.
Photo analysis and barcode scanning are not available. No data is uploaded.
Recipe inspiration. Nutrition, allergens and retail prices require professional review. Check labels and cross-contact risks.

Ingredients: red lentils, rice, tomato, turmeric, water.
1. Rinse rice and lentils separately.
2. Cook rice following its package instructions.
3. Simmer lentils with chopped tomato, turmeric and water until tender; serve with rice.

Ingredients: cooked chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, lime, coriander.
1. Wash and chop vegetables.
2. Mix with cooked chickpeas and coriander.
3. Add lime to taste and serve fresh.

Ingredients: oats, banana, peanuts, water. Contains peanuts; oats may contain gluten.
1. Cook oats in water following package instructions.
2. Add sliced banana.
3. Sprinkle peanuts. Check all ingredient labels for allergens.

Journal contents are encrypted with an Android Keystore key in a private Room database. Backup and device transfer are disabled. No Internet permission is requested. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes the journal; exported files remain wherever you saved them.
The JSON file contains readable personal entries. Choose a trusted location. A cloud document provider may upload your exported file.

A little support, whenever you need it
Find a gentle next step for your day. Choose how you would like to connect.
Scripted demo, not live AI or medical advice. Messages stay in this screen and are cleared when you leave. No journal access.
Preview a spoken reply using an installed offline device voice. No microphone recording or live conversation. ElevenLabs is not connected.
This demo replies in English or Tamil. More conversation languages require a future live service.
What would you like help with?
Hello. Let us choose one manageable step. Try asking about planning, sleep, food or gentle movement.
Try choosing one small task and a comfortable time for it. Leave space for a break. You can add it yourself in Plan.
A steady bedtime and a quiet wind-down routine may help. Record how you slept if useful. If sleep problems persist, speak with a qualified professional.
Consider regular, balanced meals that suit your needs and preferences. A food log can help you notice habits. For a personal diet or medical condition, ask a qualified dietitian.
If comfortable and safe for you, try a short gentle walk or stretch. Stop if you feel pain or unwell. Follow your clinician’s activity guidance.
This demo only has sample guidance for planning, sleep, food and movement. It cannot understand every question or give personalized advice. Choose a topic below to explore.
This demo cannot assess symptoms or emergencies. If you may be in immediate danger, contact local emergency services or seek urgent in-person care. Do not wait for this assistant.
This demo cannot diagnose, recommend treatment or change medication. Please ask a qualified clinician or pharmacist for guidance about your health concern.
Choose a topic, then play its sample reply.
